tasks.title: Missing source id provenance
tasks.prompt: Find a memory or rendered wake-style entry that lacks a usable source id, or use the repository tests/docs that define that case. Explain what can and cannot be safely claimed from it.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must treat missing source id as weakened provenance, not as full proof and not as automatic falsity.
required_facts: The answer should keep content and provenance confidence separate.
A concrete follow-up should repair or locate the source.
forbidden_claims: Missing source id is equivalent to verified source evidence.
Missing source id proves the content is false.

tasks.title: Generated-only material boundary
tasks.prompt: Investigate a generated-only token or generated wiki/cache material. Can it be used as confirmed memory evidence? Answer with the safe claim boundary.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must say generated-only material is not confirmed truth and seek underlying evidence.
required_facts: Generated prose/cache is not confirmed truth.
Generated-only material should not satisfy evidence claims by itself.
Underlying raw observation or confirmed memory evidence is required.
forbidden_claims: Generated-only search hits prove confirmed memory truth.

tasks.title: Near-neighbor packet evidence
tasks.prompt: Inspect current v2 user-test packet evidence. Pick one near-neighbor artifact and state exactly what it proves and what it does not prove.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must avoid converting near-neighbor packet/router/cache evidence into a stronger full-client transcript claim.
required_facts: States at least one not-yet-claimable stronger claim.
forbidden_claims: Near-neighbor evidence proves the full matrix.
Docs-only or cache evidence is equivalent to a client transcript.

tasks.title: Historical superseded truth boundary
tasks.prompt: Find or construct from tests a case where historical truth was superseded by current truth. Explain which truth is current and which is historical.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must not report superseded historical truth as current.
required_facts: Current and historical truth are explicitly separated.
Supersede relationship is mentioned when visible.
Historical truth is not presented as the default current answer.
forbidden_claims: History should be hidden when the user explicitly asks for history.

tasks.title: Insufficient evidence abstention
tasks.prompt: Answer a benchmark or product-status question where the current repo has only partial evidence. Provide the strongest safe answer and state what evidence is missing.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must abstain or qualify when evidence is insufficient.
required_facts: States evidence is insufficient for the stronger claim.
Lists evidence needed to close the claim.
forbidden_claims: Absence of evidence proves a broad product claim.
Partial methodology or smoke artifacts prove completed benchmark results.
